technical.summary: Bullish short-term technicals with Ichimoku cross-up and three white soldiers, but overbought RSI(9), weak ADX trend strength, and long-term bearish alignment limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: AMT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 27 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (VIX-equivalent 25) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no conviction signal from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (360.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 27 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cross-up, three white soldiers, and OBV bullish divergence signal short-term momentum reversal in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis), offering contrarian entry near support at 221.57.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI(9) overbought at 78, weak ADX trend conviction (17.73), price below both 50/200 EMAs, macro headwinds (rising dollar, flat yield curve, recession risk), and earnings binary in 27 days with zero fundamental support make this a high-risk, low-conviction swing setup.
